digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical whole-file mutation counts in signing.py are stale (814 current vs 491 recorded), containing both equivalent survivors and real contract gaps that block safe enforcement
The gate must implement three distinct enforcement modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) with shard-specific promotion criteria based on fresh base/head archives and runtime evidence
Mutation verdict cache must not persist across runs; each shard job must run in isolation with fresh archives, no cached verdicts, and exact per-shard 30-minute timeout limits
The selector must map changed source, test, and support files to their corresponding behavioral shards, handle renames and deletions, and report unmatched Python tests as advisory findings
Ratchet mode must preserve unchanged legacy survivors and no-tests outcomes while blocking killed mutant regressions, new survivors, and timeouts for AST-identical functions
Strict mode requires all mutants to be killed or individually fingerprinted as equivalent, with zero tolerance for no-tests, timeouts, incomplete statuses, and zero-mutant runs
